messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear ILSHIN Talent Team,

Your specialist search work across renewables, BESS, green hydrogen, smart grids and energy-transition leadership makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive communications. My current portfolio also intersects with large-scale solar and battery-storage investment.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy-transition growth depends on regulatory coordination, institutional trust, responsible development and cross-functional execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I remain internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
